steps.eval: window.__scroll.list = __perf.frames.filter((f) => f.t > __scroll.t).map((f) => Object.entries(f.panes).reduce((a, [k, v]) => a + (k.startsWith('can-messages') ? v : 0), 0)).sort((a, b) => a - b)

steps.note: (() => { const fs = __perf.frames.filter((f) => f.t > __scroll.t), w = __scroll.list, work = fs.map((f) => f.work).sort((a, b) => a - b); return `scroll: ${fs.length} frames, ${__perf.drops - __scroll.drops} dropped, work p99 ${work[Math.floor(work.length * 0.99)]?.toFixed(2)} max ${work.at(-1)?.toFixed(2)} ms, can-messages p50 ${w[w.length >> 1]?.toFixed(2)} p99 ${w[Math.floor(w.length * 0.99)]?.toFixed(2)} max ${w.at(-1)?.toFixed(2)} ms`; })()

steps.assert: __perf.drops === __scroll.drops || `${__perf.drops - __scroll.drops} frames dropped while scrolling the messages`
(__scroll.list[Math.floor(__scroll.list.length * 0.99)] ?? 0) <= 2 || `the message list's render p99 is ${__scroll.list[Math.floor(__scroll.list.length * 0.99)].toFixed(1)} ms while scrolling`
